hooks.prompt: Check if any source files (in src/, lib/, app/, or similar code directories) were modified in this session. If behavioral code was changed but no files in verum/ were updated, notify the user: 'Verum specs may need updating for the changes made this session. Run /verum to review.' If verum/ files were already updated, or if changes were non-behavioral (formatting, tests, docs, deps), say nothing.
